provenance_note: Official file served by the Kantei's own host as a stored static PDF with a fixed Last-Modified (Fri, 13 Mar 2026 12:59:47 GMT), before the cutoff; it carries no per-request token or timestamp, and a cache-busting request returned the same bytes. Found by the part C check, which downloaded it twice on 25 September 2026 (00:17Z-00:58Z and 01:02Z-01:18Z, the live Kantei responses the second time with a cache-busting query) with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 25 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 01:37:49Z, 01:40:49Z, 01:42:28Z (cache-busting query), 02:21:13Z, each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The minutes of the extraordinary cabinet meeting of 11 November 2024 (08:21-08:33), attended by 石破茂 内閣総理大臣, record the decision that, the special session having been convened that day, the cabinet resigns en masse under Constitution art. 70 (本日、特別国会が召集されたことに伴い、憲法第７０条により、内閣は総辞職する), to be notified to both Houses under Diet Act art. 64.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12). Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, the Official Gazette's appointment and loss-of-office notices, the Cabinet's minutes, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting designations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role: an unnamed statement or schedule row, a House of Councillors designee who never held the office, or a designation of acting ministers. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
